claims.label: Regulatory Taking (Penn Central/Lucas)
claims.note: Rarely succeeds absent a near-total wipeout of economic value; when it does, damages tend toward full pre-regulation value.

outcome.description: The first jury fixed the taking date at January 1, 2009 and awarded $4.25 million; the district court ordered a remittitur to $2,008,000, the City rejected it, and a second jury awarded HRT $1,976,820 in just compensation. The Sixth Circuit affirmed on December 22, 2025 (ripeness, res judicata, liability, bifurcation and the remittitur all upheld; Thapar, J., dissenting on res judicata). Amount used is the operative second verdict.
outcome.finalNote: Affirmed; the operative judgment is the second jury's $1,976,820 (first verdict of $4.25 million was remitted and retried).

source.caseName: HRT Enterprises v. City of Detroit, Michigan
